goal_a_reason: Free-text greetings require semantic similarity scoring to tolerate paraphrasing (e.g. 'Hi Alice!' vs 'Hello, Alice!'); deterministic string matchers would always fail valid rephrases.
goal_b_reason: Structured JSON with known values needs tree-based comparison tolerant of key ordering and minor whitespace differences without requiring an LLM.
goal_c_reason: A binary pass/fail check for the literal substring 'deployment succeeded' anywhere in the output is exactly what the contains evaluator is designed for.
